research.target_reviewed_cases: 200-500 planned; not collected in this package
research.coverage: Positive and negative outcomes; buyer/seller evidence; platform, category, region, date
research.holdout: Split by case family/source group and time before prompt tuning; deduplicate across splits

engineering: All critical money/auth/tenant scenarios in acceptance_matrix must pass; record denominators and setup. Zero failures in a finite suite is not zero production risk.
pilot: Named partner, permitted interfaces, real DeepSeek credentials and contract review, explicit small-budget user consent, incident owner, reconciled payment and refund evidence.
production: Threat/privacy review, incident and support process, backup restore rehearsal, monitoring, actual provider agreements and jurisdiction review; no claim of universal platform access.
model_activation: Exact available DeepSeek model ID, documented capabilities and account data terms verified; sandbox tool loop and role/output isolation pass before enabling live roles.
migration_evaluation: Compare single-agent and delegated roles on identical held-out tasks, including normal completions, refusals, tool correctness, cost and latency; do not assume more agents are better.
